chapter: Kirby again, Garland gigs and later recordings
title: St. Louis hotel, Nelson Williams and Kirby's band breaking up
summary: Nelson Williams replaced the trumpeter, a third Milwaukee stay followed, and Billy Kyle took the band into the 845 Club without Kirby.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Well, now, in the meantime, we go back there, and then something happened... Oh, Rostelle Reese. I think when we finished the engagement, he went to Chicago, because that's where he was from, Chicago. And we take the band into New York. We didn't ..(?).., doin' nothin'.
So we did an engagement at a hotel in St. Louis. So Kirby starts rehearsing the band again. Actually, I had never had a rehearsal with him, but now we've to replace the

trumpet player. So we brought in Nelson Williams, who used to be on the USO tour with me... Oh yeah, that's right. He was on the USO tour with me, and he brought him in the band. Good trumpet player. So we go out to this hotel in St. Louis and played the engagement there. Beautiful. In the meantime, Kirby was booked into this Cosmopolitan place in Milwaukee. He was booked in there for the third time now.

Okay, so we go back there, and Nelson Williams -- that's the time he was with us; that's his first time with us. And everybody was talking about how good the band sounds, it sounds better than ever, and so forth and so on...
Do you still have Pete Clark?
Oh yeah, Pete's still there. Oh yeah. Well, we made that engagement, then that was it. I think that's the last time we played Milwaukee.

Anyway, we come back to New York, and I think that's when Kirby went into the... No, no, no, no. Let me see. I don't know when he... No, the band broke up when we come back here. Billy Kyle... The man from the 845 Club, he didn't want Kirby in this place at all. He would take the band without Kirby. You understand? He didn't want Kirby, because Kirby had run a bill up in there, and he didn't pay it. He didn't think he was supposed to pay bills.
Anyway, Billy Kyle was takin' the band in the club. He added a bass player in Kirby's place. And we stayed there quite a while.
That was the 845 Club in the Bronx?
Yeah. The same place Kirby had worked at. The same place. We worked there four to six weeks.
